verdict.rationale: Phaser's docs say it installs with `npm install phaser`. A runtime probe confirms the npm package exists (v4.2.1, MIT, about 263k weekly downloads). It ships bundled TypeScript definitions that editors pick up automatically, and the docs claim it works with over 40 front-end frameworks including React and Vue, so it slots into an existing toolchain as an ordinary dependency. missing for 10: any evidence of tree-shaking or modular/ES-module imports, bundler-specific integration documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of bundling it into an existing app.
